pages.text: A blossom of the void, grown in your service from a single thorn.$(br2)Summoned with an $(l:rituals/overgrown_ritual)Overgrown Ritual$(): a Void Thorn on the altar, with two Crystal Fruits and two Quick-Growing Seeds.$(br2)$(italic)Requires Bosses of Mass Destruction.$()

pages.title: As a Servant
pages.text: It is rooted where it grows, so order it to stay or guard; it cannot follow you. Anything that threatens you within its reach meets every one of its attacks.$(br2)At three quarters, half and a quarter of its health it grows healing flowers that last thirty seconds.
When it withers, it leaves its soul behind. On a Dark Altar it blooms again for 500 souls.
